title: Modularity of elliptic curves, Part II: imaginary quadratic fields
summary: Starting from modularity over ℚ, this roadmap proves the source-scoped Caraiani–Newton results over imaginary CM and imaginary quadratic fields. It develops prescribed-type mod-3 and mod-5 switching, a density theorem for integral equations, explicit Cartan modular curves and their quadratic points, and unrestricted modularity when X₀(15)(F) is finite. Separate owners supply CM lifting, residual-image theory, Q-curve modularity and general Diophantine machinery; exact computation certificates remain explicit inputs.
readme: The definitive reader is research/blueprint/readmes/EllipticCurveModularityImaginaryQuadratic.md. The eight layers cover Caraiani–Newton §§6–7 in arXiv:2301.10509v3. The theorem does not assert unconditional modularity over every imaginary quadratic field. Covariant Tate modules have cyclotomic determinant; the automorphic representation is attached to their dual. All implementations are unchecked and every arithmetic computation requires a proof-producing certificate.

stages.title: Modular elliptic curves over number fields
stages.description: Define source-normalized modularity using geometric CM or a weight-zero cuspidal GL₂ representation with the dual Tate module. Establish uniqueness, all-prime comparison, full monodromy compatibility, potentially multiplicative ordinarity and transport. Targets: Modular, automorphic_unique, automorphic_all_primes, automorphic_wd, automorphic_potentially_multiplicative_ordinary, modularity_transport.

stages.title: Prescribed-type mod-3 and mod-5 switching
stages.description: Construct the number-field fixed-pairing twist adapter. Specify CM avoidance and local preparation, the independent AKT modularity seed and Hilbert selection. Prove non-CM auxiliary curves with retained Tate places and prescribed ordinary, supersingular or split-multiplicative switching at 5 and 3 and identify local automorphic factors. Targets: symplecticTwist, solvable_preparation, seed_modular, hilbert_local_selection, switch_five, switch_three, auxiliary_local_types.

stages.title: CM modularity and equation density
stages.description: Compare elliptic representations with the separate CM potentially Barsotti–Tate lifting contract. Prove CN 6.1 and its quadratic irreducibility corollary. Define the unweighted short-equation norm-height family and prove density-one modularity with the quantitative mod-5 exceptional-image estimate. Targets: elliptic_lifting_data, cm_modularity, quadratic_modularity, shortEquationFamily, density_one.

stages.title: Cartan modular curves and explicit j-maps
stages.description: Specify the compactified Cartan/mixed-level adapter, with shared general theory assigned to ModularCurvesPartII. Fix five rational j-functions, cusp and degree conventions, the mixed elliptic quotient B=225A1, its birational maps and saturated rank-one group. Targets: cartanCurve, b3J, b5J, ns3J, ns5J, s3J, B, small_curve_models, mixed_elliptic_model, B_mordell_weil, nonsplit_cartan_conic.

stages.title: Genus-one curves and rational divisor classes
stages.description: Identify X₀(15) and X(s3,b5), their quadratic torsion growth and the Gaussian exceptional comparison. Build the weighted genus-one model of X(ns3°,b5), its Jacobian and local obstruction. Prove the rational-divisor-class obstruction, classify quadratic points and deduce modularity. Targets: E15, Es35, level_fifteen_models, quadratic_level_fifteen_torsion, gaussianExceptional, gaussian_exceptional_modular, ns3b5Quartic, genus_one_model, genusOneSpecialPoints, genus_one_jacobian, genus_one_rational_picard, genus_one_quadratic_points, genus_one_points_modular.

stages.title: Genus-two curves and exceptional points
stages.description: Identify the genus-two sextic for X(b3,ns5), its Fricke action and finite twenty-element Jacobian. Use the canonical/noncanonical degree-two divisor dichotomy to classify imaginary quadratic points. Verify the ℚ(√−11) exceptional equation, full mod-5 image and modularity. Targets: b3ns5Sextic, genus_two_model, genus_two_jacobian, genus_two_divisor_dichotomy, genus_two_quadratic_points, elevenExceptional, eleven_exceptional_modular, genus_two_points_modular.

stages.title: Bielliptic quartics and quadratic divisors
stages.description: Fix both homogeneous plane quartics, their projective involutions and degree-two quotient maps to B. Certify rank-one Jacobians, torsion classes and index bounds. Apply the existing symmetric/relative Chabauty and sieve criteria to classify degree-two divisors, identify the two imaginary ℚ(√−55) pairs and deduce modularity. Targets: quartic1, quartic1Coordinates, quartic2, quartic2Coordinates, quartic_models, quarticImaginaryPoints, quartic_jacobian_ranks, quarticTorsionClasses, quartic_jacobian_torsion, quartic_pullback_indices, first_quartic_quadratic_divisors, second_quartic_quadratic_divisors, first_quartic_points_modular, second_quartic_points_modular.

stages.title: Imaginary-quadratic modularity applications
stages.description: Combine the imported residual-image classification and the four modular-curve branches to prove CN 7.1. Prove unrestricted curve modularity under finite X₀(15)(F), certify the four small imaginary fields and verify the concrete infinite-point example over ℚ(√−10). Targets: imaginary_quadratic_residual_modularity, finite_level_fifteen_modularity, small_imaginary_quadratic_modularity, sqrt_minus_ten_infinite_level_fifteen.
